name: complete-body-below-wide-numbered-heading
rows: The complete controlled paragraph explains every independent token conversion step
and preserves all source labels without consuming any neighboring section.
The final sentence remains part of the entire body paragraph.
translation: 完整的受控段落解释每个独立的词元转换步骤，并保留全部源标签，不会占用相邻小节。最后一句仍属于这一完整的正文段落。
